parse_lambda_config: parse a lambda coefficient scheduling config string into a float value and optional step schedule
build_semisupervised_translation_task: build a SemisupervisedTranslationTask to train multiple translation models simultaneously across language pairs
load_dataset_split: load a dataset split for parallel translation, back-translation, or denoising autoencoding data
run_train_step: run a training step that aggregates loss across parallel, back-translation, and denoising objectives
configure_lambda_scheduling: configure piecewise linear lambda scheduling for parallel, denoising, and on-the-fly back-translation weights
